neet_phy_u14_t01_5.working: A true: the approaching N pole is opposed, so the near face is N. B false: a receding magnet is attracted, not repelled. C true: Lenz's law follows from energy conservation. D false: F = B²l²v/R, so F ∝ v, not v². E true: P = ε²/R ∝ cos²t, which is never negative. Correct set is A, C, E.
